title: Correctness vs acceptance criteria
failFast: Any stated requirement or acceptance criterion clearly unmet → score < 90
Behavior contradicts the goal on the primary happy path → score < 90

rubric.90: Change meets goal and acceptance criteria; ready for human CR on correctness
rubric.70: Mostly meets goal; missing edge cases or secondary requirements (mustFix non-empty)
rubric.40: Primary behavior wrong or major requirements missing
rubric.0: Does not implement the requested goal

prompt.task: Score whether the change meets the stated goal and acceptance criteria
instructions: Compare the PR diff and implied behavior against the goal and requirements only
Verify by reading the real files under domain codebasePath — do not score from the goal text alone
Do not apply company-specific or language-framework rules here (other scorers own those)
Flag missing requirements, wrong behavior, and incomplete edge cases called out by the goal
Apply failFast and rubric from this scorer declaration
Give score 0-100 where 90+ means clearly shippable for human review on correctness
List mustFix items for anything that keeps the score below 90

title: Code quality
failFast: Change introduces clear dead code or unreachable paths in the touched area → score < 90
Structure is unreadable or inconsistent with surrounding modules in a way that blocks review → score < 90

rubric.90: Clarity, structure, and API fit are ready for human CR
rubric.70: Readable but with maintainability debt that should be fixed before merge pressure
rubric.40: Hard to follow, leaky abstractions, or large unnecessary complexity

prompt.task: Score clarity, structure, API fit, and dead code in the change
instructions: Assess readability, naming, modularity, and consistency with surrounding code
Flag dead code, leaky abstractions, and unnecessary complexity
Keep this portable: do not apply Taboola-specific Java/Spring rulebooks (domain java-quality owns that)
Apply failFast and rubric from this scorer declaration
Give score 0-100 where 90+ means quality is ready for human review
List mustFix items for quality blockers

title: PR hygiene
failFast: Secrets or credentials appear in the diff → score < 90
Behavior change with no tests or verification story when tests are expected for this repo → score < 90
Diff mixes unrelated concerns so humans cannot review safely → score < 90

rubric.90: PR is reviewable: scope, risk, and tests/verification are adequate for human CR
rubric.70: Reviewable with gaps (e.g. thin tests or slightly wide scope)
rubric.40: Hard to review: oversized, risky, or missing essential verification
rubric.0: Unsafe to put in front of a human reviewer

prompt.task: Score PR hygiene: diff size, naming, risky patterns, and missing tests
instructions: Assess whether the PR is reviewable (scope, clarity, test coverage for the change)
Flag risky patterns, secrets, and missing tests for changed behavior
Apply failFast and rubric from this scorer declaration
Give score 0-100 where 90+ means hygiene is ready for human review
List mustFix items for hygiene blockers
